subject: KMS segregation sampling and ephemeral BYOK access request
messages:
From: Marie Collins <marie.collins@aurora-analytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@aurora-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: KMS sampling request for SIG/CAIQ - separation of duties + ephemeral BYOK

Aditya,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG review and CAIQ evidence collection we need a small, reproducible sample package that demonstrates:
- Separation of duties (key custodians vs operators) for tenant keys used in Aurora testing accounts.
- Rotation log samples for the last 90 days (anonymized where necessary) showing key roll operations and triggering principals.
- A short ephemeral BYOK access witness: we want to observe (or receive a recorded log) of a short-lived customer-provided key being wrapped and used for a single test workload, then revoked.

Can you provide a sampling set (not full exports) and an access matrix that maps role -> action (create, wrap, rotate, revoke)? Our auditor prefers an SFTP upload or a signed transfer link. Ideally we need this by Apr 18; if that's not possible, please advise timeline and whether an on-call demo (15–30m) would suffice.

For context: Aurora will include this evidence in a SIG submission; minimal PII is ok to include as long as user identifiers are pseudonymized. If you have a preferred secure delivery method, share details.

Appreciate it — let me know the owner and ETA.

— Marie Collins
Senior Compliance Manager
Aurora Analytics
marie.collins@aurora-analytics.com

Attachments requested: list of fields we typically expect (access matrix, rotation sample, HSM attestation if available).

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marie Collins <marie.collins@aurora-analytics.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS sampling request for SIG/CAIQ - separation of duties + ephemeral BYOK

Marie — thanks for the clear list. I've looped in Irene (security & compliance) and Ben (product infra) to pull the artifacts. High-level plan:

1) We'll produce a small access matrix CSV mapping role -> allowed key operations and include the role assignment timestamps.
2) Rotation logs: we can provide a 30-entry anonymized rotation-log-sample.txt covering recent roll events (timestamps, key-id hashes, initiating principal id).
3) Ephemeral BYOK witness: we can do an interactive demo or provide a signed log capture of a single ephemeral key wrap + test invocation and revocation. We can do the live witness on Apr 14 (two 30-min windows I propose below) or upload recorded logs to your SFTP.

Delivery options (pick one):
- Secure SFTP upload to your endpoint (please confirm host & credentials) — we'll upload a password-protected archive and a checksum.
- Pre-signed time-limited HTTPS bundle (we'll host on our secure transfer service).
- Live witness over Zoom with an engineer and a compliance brief (we'll redact any userids).

Proposed witness windows (PDT): Apr 14 at 10:00 or 15:00. Please confirm which you prefer; if neither works we can propose alternatives.

I'll coordinate the file prep; Irene, Ben — can you confirm we have a rotation sample ready to sanitize and an HSM attestation blob we can share? I'll prepare the access matrix template (kms-access-matrix.csv) and the upload instructions (sftp_upload_instructions.pdf).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: kms-access-matrix.csv (template), sftp_upload_instructions.pdf (instructions).

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: KMS sampling request for SIG/CAIQ - separation of duties + ephemeral BYOK

Forwarding Marie's request and Aditya's plan. Operational notes for the rotation log sample and BYOK demo:

- Rotation-log-sample.txt will contain 30 anonymized rows: [ts, key_id_hash, event_type, principal_role, rotation_trigger]. We will replace principal identifiers with role tags (e.g., keystore-admin-001).
- HSM attestation: we have the vendor-signed attestation PDF (HSM-seal-2027.pdf) we can include; it is a static attestation for the HSM cluster used in Hosted and Dedicated modes.
- Ephemeral BYOK: we will perform a single wrap/unwrap cycle in a staging tenant we control. Steps:
   1) Customer provides an RSA/ECDSA keyfile (we'll accept a wrapped blob).
   2) We import the wrapped blob into the staging keystore using an ephemeral import key (time-limited).
   3) Trigger a single test invocation against a sandbox model endpoint, recording the KMS call and server-side wrap/unwrap trace.
   4) Immediately revoke/import-delete the key and collect the revocation record.

I'll have infra redact any IP addresses and pseudonymize principals. Ben — can you stage the tenant and confirm the export path (SFTP vs signed link)? Also note: we should not include private key material; only wrapped blobs and logs.

— Irene
Head of Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachment stubs we will produce: rotation-log-sample.txt, HSM-seal-2027.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marie Collins <marie.collins@aurora-analytics.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, compliance@aurora-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 15:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS sampling request for SIG/CAIQ - separation of duties + ephemeral BYOK

Marie — delivering the sampling package as discussed. Summary:

Delivery method: secure SFTP upload to your provided host (confirmed in separate secure channel). We placed artifacts in the folder sftp://uploads.aurora-analytics-secure.net/redwood/ACCT-4721/ (link below). Password-protected archive and SHA256 checksum included.

Files uploaded (attached to this message as stubs):
- kms-access-matrix.csv — maps internal roles to allowed key operations (create, wrap, rotate, revoke).
- rotation-log-sample.txt — 30 anonymized rotation events (timestamps, key-id-hash, event_type, role_tag).
- HSM-seal-2027.pdf — vendor attestation for the HSM cluster (static attestation provided by vendor).
- sftp_upload_instructions.pdf — manifest and instructions for pulling the archive.

Ephemeral BYOK witness: Completed in staging tenant on Apr 14 at 14:30 PDT. Agenda: intro (5m), import & wrap (10m), test invocation & logging (5m), revoke & collect artifacts (5m). We captured the KMS call trace and a signed log bundle; the signed log is included in the archive (rotation-log-sample.txt contains the relevant entry). If you'd like a live playback we can schedule a 20-minute session to step through the logs.

Notes and caveats:
- We did not export any private key material; only wrapped blobs and logs are included.
- Principal identifiers are role-tagged (keystore-admin-001, ops-deploy-002).
- If your auditor needs timestamps in UTC or an alternate time-range, we can produce a second sample.

SFTP link: sftp://uploads.aurora-analytics-secure.net/redwood/ACCT-4721/
Pre-signed bundle (48h): https://transfers.redwood.com/ACCT-4721/evidence-bundle?token=REDACTED

If this satisfies the SIG/CAIQ checklist, please confirm and we'll mark the task complete. Otherwise tell us what else the auditor needs and we will iterate quickly.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachments: kms-access-matrix.csv (csv), rotation-log-sample.txt (txt), HSM-seal-2027.pdf (pdf), sftp_upload_instructions.pdf (pdf)
